brief:
Settlers conducted coordinated incursions Sunday across multiple locations in Ramallah and Al-Bireh governorate, ransacking Palestinian-owned agricultural land and residential properties, the Shehab Wire reported. The simultaneous attacks involved vandalism, desecration, and provocative actions targeting citizens and their homes throughout the district.

The raids struck scattered areas within the governorate, with settlers carrying out destruction across both farmland and inhabited structures. Authorities documented the incidents as part of an escalating pattern of settler violence in the West Bank territory. Palestinian residents reported significant property damage from the Sunday operations.
title: Settlers attack Palestinian properties across Ramallah in coordinated raids
